description: Feature registry for documentation coverage checks. Status values: implemented (shipped and verified), experimental (works but with real limitations), planned (not implemented — must never be documented as available). Ubuntu 24.04 LTS ARM64 is the one installable Noxs environment (BuiltinProviders: 'no distribution selector and no Debian fallback'); Kali and the legacy Debian import are model-level concepts only.

features.name: Terminal emulator (Ubuntu 24.04 LTS ARM64)
features.description: Multi-session terminal on proot Ubuntu 24.04 LTS; primary Noxs environment.

features.name: Kali Linux ARM64 environment
features.description: Referenced by the environment variant model (Kali full/minimal/nano) but NO provider, installer or rootfs pipeline exists yet. Never document Kali as installable.

features.name: SAF storage access (7 categories)
features.description: Per-category SAF document-tree access: shared, downloads, dcim, pictures, music, movies, documents. Command-based; never presented as a POSIX mount.

features.name: Opt-in direct /sdcard mount
features.description: MANAGE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE (user-approved in Android Settings) + explicit 'noxs storage mount' toggle expose /sdcard and ~/storage/* links in NEW sessions. Default off; SAF stays the recommended model.

features.name: Documents provider + file browser UI
features.description: NoxsDocumentsProvider exposes the Linux home to Android document UIs; FileBrowserActivity browses Linux home and SAF-backed folders.

features.name: NX Android Integration bridge
features.description: File-based request/response IPC for files/document/sms/device/notification/share/camera/clipboard/network/storage-mount plus app-version and open-url deep links.

features.name: NX Package System
features.description: nx pkg init/build/release/deploy + mirror-first installer with sha256 caching; language templates for node, rust, cpp, python, go.

features.name: Plugin system + Plugin Store
features.description: Manifest-validated plugins with explicit permission boundaries; nx plug store UI.

features.name: NX AI agent
features.description: Guest-side AI agent (ai-lib.sh + NoxsNxAiAgent); provider configured by the user, API keys never printed.

features.name: VS Code (code-server)
features.description: Local-only code-server lifecycle driven by the CLI and the Noxs editor screen.

features.name: Docker compatibility mode
features.description: Docker daemon inside proot; container execution is kernel-dependent and honestly reported by 'noxs docker test'.

features.name: Tor over PRoot (nx vpn)
features.description: Guest-side Tor routing for new shells; network paths remain subject to proot/Android limits.

features.name: NoxOS emulator screen (QEMU/VNC)
features.description: Experimental screen for the separate private NoxOS project; NOT part of the Noxs terminal product. Do not document as a Noxs feature.

features.name: Legacy Debian environment import
features.description: Pre-migration Debian installs are imported read-only by NoxsEnvironmentManager (never erased, user data kept). Not a provider; fresh installs are always Ubuntu.
